say:1:1610824001:1.text: I'd say you've passed this little test with flying colors!
say:1:1610824001:1.source_cn: 我宣布，你们顺利通过了这次小测试，非常好！
say:1:1610824001:1.male: I'd say you've passed this little test with flying colors!
say:1:1610824001:1.female: I'd say you've passed this little test with flying colors!

say:4:1610824002:1.text: Professor, can we go take the main exam now?
say:4:1610824002:1.source_cn: 赫普老师，我们现在可以去参加选拔赛了吧？

say:7:1610824003:1.text: Hold on, I've got a few more things to say.
say:7:1610824003:1.source_cn: 请稍等，我还有几句话想对你们说。
say:7:1610824003:1.male: Hold on, I've got a few more things to say.
say:7:1610824003:1.female: Hold on, I've got a few more things to say.

say:8:1610824004:1.text: You're among our best students. Whatever happens in this selection, I'll be proud of you.
say:8:1610824004:1.source_cn: 你们是莱希拉姆的精英学生，无论这次选拔赛的结果如何，我...
say:8:1610824004:1.male: You're among our best students. Whatever happens in this selection, I'll be proud of you.
say:8:1610824004:1.female: You're among our best students. Whatever happens in this selection, I'll be proud of you.

say:9:1610824005:1.text: Becoming a court mage is just one path you could take. It might be the obvious one, but it's not the only choice.
say:9:1610824005:1.source_cn: 但成为宫廷魔法师，只不过是许多条路中的一条而已，或许它...
say:9:1610824005:1.male: Becoming a court mage is just one path you could take. It might be the obvious one, but it's not the only choice.
say:9:1610824005:1.female: Becoming a court mage is just one path you could take. It might be the obvious one, but it's not the only choice.

say:10:1610824006:1.text: Your futures are bigger than this. The world has far more to offer than what you see here.
say:10:1610824006:1.source_cn: 你们的未来绝非仅限于此，而世界远比你眼前所见到的更广阔。
say:10:1610824006:1.male: Your futures are bigger than this. The world has far more to offer than what you see here.
say:10:1610824006:1.female: Your futures are bigger than this. The world has far more to offer than what you see here.

say:11:1610824007:1.text: Remember: explore the world with respect, and practice magic with reverence. Whatever path you choose, carry those principles with you.
say:11:1610824007:1.source_cn: 探索世界，必先尊重世界；研究魔法，但须敬畏魔法——无论...
say:11:1610824007:1.male: Remember: explore the world with respect, and practice magic with reverence. Whatever path you choose, carry those principles with you.
say:11:1610824007:1.female: Remember: explore the world with respect, and practice magic with reverence. Whatever path you choose, carry those principles with you.

say:12:1610824008:1.text: Ahem. I can see I've lost you both. You look about as lively as two slugs in salt.
say:12:1610824008:1.source_cn: 咳，你们一定听烦了吧？你们两人的表情已经像失去了太阳的...
say:12:1610824008:1.male: Ahem. I can see I've lost you both. You look about as lively as two slugs in salt.
say:12:1610824008:1.female: Ahem. I can see I've lost you both. You look about as lively as two slugs in salt.

say:13:1610824009:1.text: I won't keep you any longer. Go on, get moving.
say:13:1610824009:1.source_cn: 好了，我就不耽误你们的时间了，出发吧。
say:13:1610824009:1.male: I won't keep you any longer. Go on, get moving.
say:13:1610824009:1.female: I won't keep you any longer. Go on, get moving.
